candidate_ideas.statement: Study density and adjacency of Casnati–Ekedahl splitting strata to prove irreducibility of the balanced h^0=3 locus.
Recover the tetragonal pencil functorially in families from the relative canonical model to establish full faithfulness or quasi-finiteness of the forgetful morphism.
Compute the étale monodromy image in S_6 to determine connected components of the ordered incidence and the associated local systems.
Construct a stratified closed-embedding description of the incidence image before applying codimension, Gysin, or purity arguments.

established_facts.evidence: Section 1 computes the normal sheaf as torsion of length b=2g+6=18 with H^1=0 and h^0=18; quotienting by the 3-dimensional PGL_2 action gives dimension 15. Stabilizers inject into the finite automorphism group of the genus-6 source curve, and balancedness is open by semicontinuity of h^1(F(-5)).
established_facts.statement: The balanced tetragonal Hurwitz stack H is a smooth finite-stabilizer Deligne-Mumford stack, equidimensional of dimension 15; its generic stabilizer is trivial.

established_facts.evidence: Sections 2.1–2.2 and 3.3 identify the h^0=4 stratum with a proper closed substack contained in the non-primitive hyperelliptic locus.
established_facts.statement: The primitive locus is contained in H_3; H_3 is a nonempty dense open substack of H of dimension 15, while dim(H_4) is at most 14.

established_facts.evidence: Sections 2.2–2.3 construct the relative linear system on each reduced constant-h^0 stratum and identify its fibres with P(H^0(L)), of dimension k-1.
established_facts.statement: For every reduced stratum H_k, the Abel–Jacobi incidence restricts to a Zariski-locally trivial projective-space bundle I|_{H_k}→H_k with fibre P^{k-1}, hence dim(I|_{H_k})=dim(H_k)+k-1.

established_facts.evidence: The projective-bundle formula gives 15+3-1=17 over H_3 and dim(H_4)+4-1≤14+3=17 over H_4; the nonempty H_3 stratum supplies a 17-dimensional component.
established_facts.statement: The restriction I|_{H_3} is smooth and equidimensional of dimension 17; every component over H_4 has dimension at most 17, and I has dimension 17.

established_facts.evidence: Section 3.1 applies Zariski-local triviality with irreducible fibre P^2, which preserves and reflects irreducible components.
established_facts.statement: Irreducible components of I|_{H_3} correspond bijectively to irreducible components of H_3, so I|_{H_3} is irreducible if and only if H_3 is irreducible.

established_facts.evidence: Sections 4.1–4.2 identify the ordered configuration cover with the free permutation torsor on six distinct sections; finite étale pullback preserves dimension.
established_facts.statement: Over the distinct-support incidence, ordering the six points defines a finite étale S_6-torsor of dimension 17 at stack level.

established_facts.evidence: Section 4.2 gives the standard component-orbit description of a finite étale torsor through its étale monodromy action.
established_facts.statement: For a connected component V of the distinct-support incidence, the number of connected components of its ordered cover equals [S_6:Im(π_1^ét(V)→S_6)].

established_facts.evidence: Section 4.3 shows that three distinct marked images force the induced PGL_2 transformation to be the identity; an automorphism over P^1 fixing an unramified marked point is then the identity.
established_facts.statement: On the dense open where the six marked points have at least three distinct images in P^1 and at least one marked point is unramified, the ordered stabilizer is trivial.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: A P^{k-1}-bundle has dimension dim(H_k)+k-1. The base need not have dimension 15; in particular dim(H_4)≤14.
invalid_steps.statement: For every reduced H_k, infer dim(I|_{H_k})=15+k-1.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: An open splitting stratum need not be dense or irreducible merely because the ambient Hurwitz space is irreducible; density and connectivity of the relevant splitting stratum require proof.
invalid_steps.statement: Infer irreducibility of the balanced open H_3 directly from irreducibility of the classical Hurwitz space.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Six fixed points do not exceed the genus-6 bound 2g+2=14, and the available argument controls only a dense open with at least three distinct target images and an unramified mark.
invalid_steps.statement: Infer that every reduced ordered point has trivial stabilizer from the six marked points.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: A positive upper bound on exceptional fibre dimension does not imply zero-dimensional fibres, so it does not establish quasi-finiteness or the asserted finite-fibre image-dimension argument.
invalid_steps.statement: Infer global finiteness or quasi-finiteness of the forgetful morphism from injectivity over H_3 and fibre dimension at most two over H_4.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: A stack monomorphism requires full faithfulness on objects over every base scheme; fibrewise recovery does not control families, especially where π_*(ω(-Γ)) changes rank.
invalid_steps.statement: Infer that a morphism of stacks is a monomorphism from injectivity on geometric points and injectivity on automorphism groups.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: The Euler-characteristic argument yields a nonempty complete Abel–Jacobi fibre in Sym^6, but does not ensure a divisor with six distinct support points.
invalid_steps.statement: Infer nonempty distinct-support ordered incidence on every fibre from χ(L)=1.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Rational representation theory alone does not determine the geometric monodromy image, Hodge type, weights, or Tate purity of the resulting local systems.
invalid_steps.statement: Infer Tate or only-Tate local systems from rationality of S_6-representations.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: When h^0 jumps, π_*L need not be locally free or commute with base change; reduced constant-rank strata are needed for the projective-bundle identification.
invalid_steps.statement: Identify the relative linear system globally with Proj(π_*L) across h^0-jumping strata or a nonreduced base.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Constructible image dimension does not imply closedness, purity of codimension, regularity, or the existence of a suitable closed embedding.
invalid_steps.statement: Infer a closed pure-codimension-four locus and a Gysin map solely from a 17-dimensional constructible image in a 21-dimensional moduli stack.

unresolved_dependencies.statement: Irreducibility of H_3, and hence of I|_{H_3}, remains to be proved.
Emptiness of H_4 is unknown, so global equidimensionality of I is not established.
The étale monodromy image in S_6 has not been computed.
The fibrewise weak Casnati–Ekedahl relative-canonical normalization needed to recover the tetragonal pencil remains unproved.
Full faithfulness on arbitrary families, and therefore the monomorphism property of the forgetful morphism, remains unresolved.
Global finiteness or quasi-finiteness of the forgetful morphism and the resulting 17-dimensional constructible-image assertion require an additional argument.
Neither closedness nor non-closedness of the forgetful image, nor a stratified closed-embedding model for it, is known.
Nonemptiness of the distinct-support incidence on every geometric fibre remains unproved.
Triviality of ordered stabilizers outside the stated dense open remains unresolved.
